analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Lincoln Red Imps (22nd, three points) host Midtjylland (34th, one point) in Gibraltar on matchday 5. Midtjylland lead the Danish league unbeaten but have one point in Europe after a 6-1 home defeat by Ajax; Kjell-Arik Wätjen, sent off in that game, should be available again if his ban is the usual one match. Lincoln beat Hajduk 1-0 at home but lost 4-1 to Twente there.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, 2.0 for Midtjylland. Lincoln's two home games ended 1-0 and 1-4, so they can either shut a game down or be overrun; Midtjylland's 27 league goals in 13 games suggest they will score. I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 5.3 for Midtjylland. Nothing I read moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. No referee is known this far out, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.5 shots. I lean a little higher: by matchday 5 Midtjylland will very likely need a win, and they are a strong attacking side domestically, so expect them to pile on attempts against a deep Lincoln side.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. More Midtjylland volume would push this up, but Lincoln defended well against Hajduk; I stay with the number.
